Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Miramar Elm Wood Cutout Side End Table, 19.7"D, Natural
Colors: Ash
Materials: Elm
Beautiful texture and grain, combined with clever modern side openings, give this end table the appearance of a hollowed-out log. It's the perfect place for a houseplant, lamp, or cup of coffee, and a handsome conversation piece all in one. 19.7" Diameter, 21.65"H Elm wood shows natural grain A modern rustic piece that works with modern and modern farmhouse décor Sturdy and durable with display space for magazines or a laptop underneath No assembly required. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
